comment: The component variants of the token contract (spec §5.5): for each component, the variants the founder can choose between. The recipes say which tokens each variant uses.

components.name: Buttons
components.why: The main action on a page.

cands.name: Filled
cands.note: A solid brand colour: the strongest.

cands.name: Soft tint
cands.note: A pale tint of the brand colour: gentle.

components.name: Links
components.why: How a link shows that it is one.

cands.name: Colour only
cands.note: Underlined on hover; its colour must differ from the text.

components.name: Cards
components.why: How a block of content is set apart.

cands.name: Raised
cands.note: A tinted background with the card's shadow.

components.name: Messages
components.why: How a success, a warning or an error is told.

cands.name: Tinted box
cands.note: A pale box in the message colour.

cands.name: Side bar
cands.note: A coloured bar on the side.

components.name: Navigation
components.why: Where the logo and the menu sit.

cands.name: Logo left
cands.note: The logo at the start, the links at the end.

cands.name: Logo centred
cands.note: The logo in the middle, the links beneath.

cands.name: Framed
cands.note: A margin around it, like a print.

components.name: Icons
components.why: The style of the small pictures.
